headline: PulteGroup Earns 2026-2027 Great Place To Work Certification™
summary: ATLANTA, August 06, 2026--More than nine out of ten PulteGroup employees say the company is a great place to work, according to the latest Great Place To Work® survey. Based on employee feedback, PulteGroup, Inc. (NYSE: PHM), America's third-largest homebuilding company, has earned Great Place To Work Certification™ for the eighth time. This year, 92% of employees said PulteGroup is a great place to work, compared with 57% at a typical U.S. company.
